root_cause.text: The driver invoked pm_runtime_get_sync() before i2c_dw_probe(), which triggered a runtime resume call that raced with the probe routine and caused a NULL dereference because the device was not yet fully initialized.
root_cause.evidence: CVE description states: "The pm_runtime_get_sync() called before i2c_dw_probe() triggers PM resume, which powers on ISP and also invokes the amdisp i2c runtime resume before the probe completes resulting in this race condition and a NULL dereferencing issue." The patch replaces pm_runtime_get_sync/pm_runtime_put_sync with dev_pm_genpd_resume/dev_pm_genpd_suspend and adds pm_runtime_set_suspended before pm_runtime_enable to ensure runtime PM is only enabled after probe.
